CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'PA Rejected'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Expired') ), TEXT(Status__c), IF( AND( Total_TNP_Tests__c = 0, Total_Resulted_Tests__c = 0, Total_In_Progress_Tests__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Tests__c =0 ), 'Registered', IF( Total_Number_of_Tests__c = Total_Resulted_Tests__c, 'Results Ready', IF( Total_Number_of_Tests__c = Total_TNP_Tests__c, 'TNP', IF( AND( Total_In_Progress_Tests__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Tests__c =0 , Total_TNP_Tests__c > 0, Total_Number_of_Tests__c <> Total_Resulted_Tests__c, Total_Resulted_Tests__c > 0 ), 'Results Ready', IF( Total_Partial_Resulted_Tests__c > 0, 'Partial Results Ready', 'In Progress' ) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Panel Status
